records.body:

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Glad to hear the first week has gone smoothly, and that the layout is starting to click. I also saw your open ticket asking about SSO for your organization -- SSO is available on the Team plan, and our support team is following up there with more detail.

In the meantime, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting your team working on shared tasks is usually the step that makes things stick. Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you.

Best,
Chidi
